scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: When the customer tells you, 'I know your boss, can you make it cheaper?', never say 'Then call the boss yourself.' It feels good but loses the order.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: I met Mr. Wang at the showroom. We discussed features and maintenance, took a test drive, and returned to the desk to view the quote.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: He tapped the table and said, 'Tai Xin, I actually know your boss. Can you make this price more attractive?'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Every salesperson faces this. Your first thought is 'Really? Why didn't you say so before? Are you just trying to haggle with me?'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: If I were younger, I might say, 'Well, ask the boss then,' or 'Even if the boss comes, it is still this price.'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Logically these are correct, but sales is not a debate. The more right you are, the harder it is for the client to back down.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: He mentions the boss to get respect. He wants to know if I treat him as an important person. I didn't expose him.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: I said: 'I understand. Since you know the boss, I absolutely cannot casually serve you. You are my VIP.'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: He leaned in because I didn't insult him. I told him I didn't use a high-price tactic for him because he's a friend of the boss.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: The point isn't that it can't be cheaper, but that I respect you and didn't treat you like an outsider.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: I said: 'I can't mess with price, but I'll arrange exclusive car delivery and maintenance service for you, which ordinary customers don't get.'

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: He asked if the price was really firm. I said if I cut it just to close, you'd worry I had more room I didn't give you.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: I want you to buy with peace of mind. Stable price, great service. He paused, then told me to write it down. The order closed.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: No magic tricks, just one sequence: Give face first, uphold the rules, then use service to replace price cuts.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Most fail here because they either fold or get defensive. If you fold, the quote looks dishonest. If you're hard, the client feels insulted.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: True closing is: I understand your need for status, but my rules are firm. Firm stance, gentle attitude, better service.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Let the client decide with dignity. I've compiled a 'Face-Saving Closing' cheat sheet. Comment 'face' for a copy. Close high-value deals with me.
